reply.text: I can see you're after a workout, and I'm glad you're interested in training. Before I build anything, I want to check a few things about your setup. Could you tell me your first name and how old you are as the app has it on your profile? Once I know more about where you train and what equipment you have, I can put together something safe and suitable for you. If you're under 18, it's a good idea to check the plan with a parent or guardian too.
